'''Mr. Jensen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[moisture farmer]] and the neighbor and friend of [[Ariq Joanson]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with his wife. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with Jawas and Tuskens, because they broke five of his [[moisture vaporator]]s.
